summary:
Iter79: NEW 2x2 SNAPSHOT redesign verified across Sample Report web, Premium Report web (real non-demo), Free Preview web, and PDF (via /api/reports/{id}/pdf).

(1) /sample-report: v2-snapshots-section renders NEW cream layout — 'SNAPSHOT' + 'The key moments we found in Noah's match.' + snapshot-demo-note ('Sample visuals…'). All 4 cards present with colored header bars, category badges and timestamps exactly as spec: strength=BIGGEST STRENGTH/00:58/'One-v-one dribbling that produces goals'; noticed=SCOUT NOTICED/01:28/'Great scan before the pass'; hidden=HIDDEN TALENT/03:59/'Back-post runs timed like an older player'; develop=BIGGEST DEVELOPMENT AREA/02:40/'Left foot as a real option'. snapshot-progress strip shows 'OVERALL PROGRESS' + 'A standout profile developing exactly the right habits — keep going!' + 'Keep working and enjoying the game.'. All 4 demo images loaded (naturalWidth 1264). OLD design fully removed (v2-next-milestone/glance/quote all count=0). Regression sections intact (v2-match-stats-card, v2-age-comparison-card, v2-top-strengths-card, v2-dev-priorities-card, v2-roadmap-card, v2-report-footer). Mobile 390px: scrollWidth=390 == clientWidth, section width=390 → no horizontal overflow, cards stack 1-col.

(2) Premium Report web (seeded unlocked report for disposable user smtest.iter78, is_paid=true + manually_unlocked=true): v2-snapshots-section renders with 'in your match.' subtitle and NO demo-note. All 4 cards render — strength/noticed/develop have real timestamps (00:15, 01:32, 02:40) and titles from action_timeline; strength+noticed have real photos (matching video_comments frame_url), hidden+develop show stylized dark-green pitch fallback (no invented photo). Hidden card has no timestamp because no matching action_timeline event exists — consistent with iter78 known behavior.

(3) Free Preview web (seeded LOCKED report): fpl-snapshots section uses new card design; fpl-snapshots-count pill='1 OF 4 UNLOCKED'; fpl-snapshot-open renders with green BIGGEST STRENGTH header + real poster + fpl-snapshot-open-title='Explosive 1v1 dribbling'; fpl-snapshot-locked-0/1/2 render with correct category headers (SCOUT NOTICED, HIDDEN TALENT, BIGGEST DEVELOPMENT AREA) + 'UNLOCKS WITH THE FULL REPORT'. No premium content leaked. fpl-snapshots-unlock button click scrolls to #scout-packages. Regression: fpl-hero, fpl-insights, fpl-key-moment render; pricing tier UI visible in screenshot.

(4) PDF via API (GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf with Bearer token for unlocked report): HTTP 200, application/pdf, 196KB. Rendered with fitz → 7 pages total (base 4→5 + report content). Page 2 = SNAPSHOT dedicated page containing: 'SNAPSHOT' heading, 'The key moments we found in your match.', all 4 category labels (BIGGEST STRENGTH 00:15 / SCOUT NOTICED 01:32 / HIDDEN TALENT / BIGGEST DEVELOPMENT AREA 02:40), OVERALL PROGRESS strip with 'On the right track!' + 'Keep working and enjoying the game.'. All 7 pages have sequential footers 'PAGE N / 7'. Later sections still render (TOP STRENGTHS pg3, VIDEO HIGHLIGHT + NEXT LEVEL pg4, NUMBERS TRANSLATED pg5, TRAINING WEEK PLANNER pg6, CERTIFICATE pg7) — no crash.

No red console errors on any page. All disposable test data (user + 2 reports) DELETED after test.
critical_code_review_comments: snapshots.jsx (real mode): HIDDEN TALENT card still shows no timestamp when the snapshot phrase doesn't token-match any action_timeline event. Iter78 flagged the same. Consider a soft fallback timestamp from the nearest scout event (e.g. first 'noticed'/'pass' event) or hide the header timestamp column consistently across all cards with no ts so the header bar is symmetric. Not blocking.

PDF page 2 renders the HIDDEN TALENT title twice ('Sharp pre-scan before receiving' appears both as title and as description) when full_report.snapshot.hidden_talent is present but no distinct description exists. Consider deriving a separate short body sentence or trimming the description when it equals the title. Not blocking.

PremiumReportV2.jsx testids v2-action-timeline and v2-training-week are still not exposed on real reports (only stat/age/strengths/priorities/roadmap/footer). Minor testability gap carried over from iter78.

seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/tests/seed_iter78_fpl.py which created 1 free user + 1 locked report + 1 unlocked report; then updated unlocked report with is_paid=true + manually_unlocked=true. All DELETED after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter79 fully verified new SNAPSHOT layout on all 4 surfaces (sample web, premium web, free preview web, PDF via API). To retest: run /app/backend/tests/seed_iter78_fpl.py, set is_paid=true+manually_unlocked=true on the unlocked report doc, then hit GET /api/reports/{id}/pdf with user token; PDF page 2 must be SNAPSHOT. Two minor cosmetic follow-ups noted in critical_code_review_comments (HIDDEN card timestamp fallback + duplicated title/description on PDF page 2 for hidden talent when no explicit description exists).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two minor cosmetic follow-ups documented in code review comments.
